::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes

[Appetizer]{.badge .badge-apps}
:::

*Fresh, light, and bursting with flavor.*

## Ingredients

- 1–2 cups popcorn shrimp (frozen)
- ½ cup onion (diced)
- cilantro (chopped)
- 1 lemon (juice)
- 1 avocado (diced)
- ½ tomato (diced)
- 1–2 tsp apple cider vinegar
- 1–2 cups spicy V8
- garlic salt (to taste)
- paprika (to taste)
- cayenne (to taste)
- cumin (to taste)
- black pepper (to taste)

## Instructions

1. Mix all ingredients together and chill.
2. Best if marinated overnight.
